title: The Repair Shop That Shared Its Tools
title_ja: 工具を共有する修理店
fact_notes: 登場人物・出来事・観察結果は架空の教材例。実測値・実在資料を主張しない。リンクは制作台帳であり外部の実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: In an imaginary neighborhood, three small repair shops occupied different rooms in the same commercial building and served many of the same residents.
sentences.ja: ある架空の地域では、小規模な修理店3軒が同じ商業施設内の別々の部屋を利用し、多くの共通する住民にサービスを提供していた。

sentences.en: Although the owners repaired different kinds of products, each business occasionally needed expensive equipment that was used for only a few hours every month.
sentences.ja: 経営者たちは異なる製品を修理していたが、各店では月に数時間しか使わない高価な設備が時々必要だった。

sentences.en: One owner proposed that the businesses purchase some of this equipment together instead of investing separately in identical machines.
sentences.ja: 一人の経営者は、同じ機械に個別に投資する代わりに一部の設備を共同購入することを提案した。

sentences.en: At first, the other owners welcomed the suggestion because it appeared to reduce the financial burden on each individual business.
sentences.ja: 当初、他の経営者も各店の経済的負担を軽減できそうだったため、提案を歓迎した。

sentences.en: However, they soon discovered that the difficulty of the proposal was not limited to finding enough money for the initial purchase.
sentences.ja: しかしすぐに、提案の難しさは最初の購入資金を確保することに限られないと分かった。

sentences.en: Each owner wanted to use the equipment whenever a customer requested a repair, and two urgent requests could easily occur at the same time.
sentences.ja: 各経営者は客から修理依頼があればいつでも設備を使いたいと望み、二つの急ぎの依頼が同時に発生する可能性もあった。

sentences.en: They also needed to determine who would pay for maintenance and how they would respond if a machine was accidentally damaged.
sentences.ja: さらに、保守費用を誰が支払い、機械が偶然壊れた場合にどう対応するか決める必要があった。

sentences.en: Without clear arrangements, a financial benefit could be accompanied by conflicts that damaged the relationship between the businesses.
sentences.ja: 明確な取り決めがなければ、経済的利益と同時に店舗間の関係を損なう対立が起こり得た。

sentences.en: Instead of purchasing several machines immediately, the owners decided to rent one piece of equipment for a trial period lasting two months.
sentences.ja: すぐに複数の機械を購入せず、2か月間の試行期間に一つの設備を借りることにした。

sentences.en: They established a reservation system that showed when the machine was available and required each user to record its condition afterward.
sentences.ja: 機械が利用できる時間を示し、各利用者に使用後の状態を記録させる予約制度を作った。

sentences.en: They also agreed to divide regular maintenance costs equally but discuss unusual incidents separately on the basis of written records.
sentences.ja: 定期保守費は均等に分け、例外的な事故などは記録に基づいて個別に話し合うことにも合意した。

sentences.en: During the trial, the owners recorded delays, expenses, and occasions when the equipment remained unused despite being reserved.
sentences.ja: 試行期間中、経営者は遅延、費用、予約されていても設備が使われなかった場合を記録した。

sentences.en: At the end of the trial, their records suggested that sharing was practical for some tasks but less convenient for repairs requiring immediate attention.
sentences.ja: 試行終了時、記録は一部の作業には共有が実用的だが、即時対応が必要な修理には不便だと示唆していた。

sentences.en: The owners therefore decided to purchase a single machine together while continuing to maintain separate equipment for their most urgent work.
sentences.ja: そこで一台を共同購入し、最も急ぐ作業用には引き続き個別の設備を維持すると決めた。

sentences.en: They prepared an agreement explaining the reservation procedure and the responsibilities of each participating business.
sentences.ja: 予約手順と各参加店舗の責任を説明する合意書を作った。

sentences.en: The agreement also included a process for reviewing the arrangement whenever one business experienced a significant change in demand.
sentences.ja: いずれかの店で需要が大きく変化した際に取り決めを見直す手順も含めた。

sentences.en: The owners learned that sharing resources is not merely a method of reducing the purchase price of expensive equipment.
sentences.ja: 経営者は資源の共有が高価な設備の購入価格を下げるだけの方法ではないと学んだ。

sentences.en: It requires participants to consider the different circumstances in which they will need those resources and to prepare for possible disagreements.
sentences.ja: 参加者は資源が必要になる異なる状況を考慮し、起こり得る意見の相違に備えることが求められる。

sentences.en: A successful arrangement must balance financial efficiency with the reliability of the services that each business provides to its customers.
sentences.ja: 良い取り決めは、経済的効率と各店舗が客に提供するサービスの信頼性を両立させなければならない。

sentences.en: For the repair shops, the trial was valuable because it revealed the conditions under which cooperation could actually work.
sentences.ja: 修理店にとって試行には、協力が実際に機能する条件が明らかになったという価値があった。

questions.prompt: Why did the owners consider buying equipment together?
options: They wanted to close all three businesses.
They had been told to stop repairing products.
Some expensive machines were rarely used by each shop.
questions.explanation_ja: 高価でも使用頻度の低い機械があった。

questions.prompt: What benefit did they initially expect?
options: A guarantee of more urgent repair requests.
A lower financial burden for each business.
questions.explanation_ja: 各店の経済的負担軽減を期待した。

questions.prompt: What could create competition between the shops?
options: Two customers might need the same machine at the same time.
Every shop used completely unrelated equipment.
The building had several empty rooms.
All customers always booked repairs months ahead.
questions.explanation_ja: 同時に設備が必要になる場合があった。

questions.prompt: Which further issue did the owners identify?
options: The color of the commercial building.
Responsibility for maintenance and accidental damage.
The location of a new examination center.
questions.explanation_ja: 保守費と故障時の対応が課題。

questions.prompt: How did they test the idea first?
options: They rented one machine for two months.
questions.explanation_ja: 一台を借りて2か月試した。

questions.prompt: What did the reservation system require users to record?
options: The price of the entire building.

questions.prompt: Why did they keep separate equipment for urgent jobs?
options: The trial showed that no shared equipment had any value.
Sharing could cause inconvenient delays for immediate repairs.
The owners refused to cooperate on any purchases.
questions.explanation_ja: 急ぐ作業に共有は不便な場合があった。

questions.prompt: Why was reviewing the agreement important?
options: A change in one shop's demand could affect the arrangement.
The written agreement had to be lost every month.
The shops intended to stop serving residents.
Every customer had to become an owner.
questions.explanation_ja: 需要変化に応じて見直す必要。

options: Joint purchases always eliminate business risks.
Independent businesses should never share resources.
A low purchase price is the only measure of success.
Resource sharing works best when costs, access, and responsibilities are considered together.
questions.explanation_ja: 価格だけでなく利用と責任を考慮する。

grammar.explanation_ja: thatはsystemを修飾し、when節は利用可能時刻を示す。

grammar.explanation_ja: balance A with BはAとBの両立。
